releases.name: Fishing Valley Remastered
releases.summary:
A fishing adventure where every cast takes you further.

One small boat. One simple rod. A whole valley waiting beyond the next haven.

Fishing Valley Remastered is a quest-driven fishing journey where every trip takes you a little farther. Travel from haven to haven, meet new characters, take on quests, and unlock new waters filled with new species and challenges to discover.

Every catch can move your journey forward. Sell your haul to upgrade your fishing gear and boat, opening the way to more distant waters and tougher catches — or keep your favorite fish and give them a home in your own aquarium.

Some species are easy to find. Others may take the right location, the right equipment, and a little more skill. Chase rare catches, complete your collection, follow the story, or simply take the boat out and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of fishing at your own pace.

• Travel from haven to haven and take on quests along the way
• Discover and collect a variety of fish species
• Upgrade your fishing gear and boat to reach new waters
• Keep your favorite catches and grow your own aquarium
• Follow the story or simply enjoy fishing at your own pace

releases.name: Counter Squad
releases.summary:
Every mission is a new test of your leadership.

Step into the world of Counter Squad, an intense tactical shooter where every operation demands skill, teamwork, and smart decision-making. Command an experienced special forces unit as you clear hostile territory, eliminate armed threats, protect civilians, and complete dangerous assignments in enemy-controlled locations. Success depends on careful planning and flawless execution.

Features:
• Lead an Elite Squad – Take charge of a professional tactical unit trained for high-risk combat operations.
• Plan Every Assault – Use strategy, positioning, and quick decisions to overcome heavily defended enemies.
• Action-Packed Combat – Experience exciting firefights with realistic weapons and responsive shooting mechanics.
• Challenging Operations – Complete a variety of mission objectives while unlocking new equipment and increasingly difficult assignments.
• Multiple Combat Locations – Fight through city blocks, industrial facilities, military compounds, and other hostile environments.
• Constant Battlefield Pressure – Adapt to unexpected enemy movements, reinforcements, and evolving combat situations.

Every mission puts your leadership to the test. Stay focused, protect your team, and complete every objective to prove that Counter Squad is ready for any challenge.

releases.name: Easy Fishing Simulator
releases.summary: Easy Fishing Simulator invites you to unwind by the water with the most accessible fishing experience yet.Cast your line, wait for a bite, and reel in your catch - every step is designed to feel intuitive and rewarding, whether you're a fishing veteran or picking up a rod for the first time.Simple, satisfying gameplay:Cast, hook, and fight fish with easy-to-learn controls. Feel the tension on your line as you reel in everything from tiny minnows to trophy-sized catches.Living waters:Fish behave naturally - swimming, exploring, and reacting to your bait. Every species has its own personality, from cautious bottom feeders to aggressive predators chasing your lure.Progress at your own pace:Sell your catch, earn money, and upgrade your gear to reach new fishing spots and land bigger fish. Keep your favorites or release them back into the water - the choice is yours.Relaxing by designNo pressure, no timers, no stress. Just you, the water, and the next big catch.Grab your rod and cast your first line today.Key features- Easy-to-learn fishing controls, perfect for all ages- Realistic fish behavior and multiple species to discover- Catch, sell, and upgrade your equipment- Relaxing, low-pressure gameplay- Save your progress and keep building your collection

releases.name: Delivery Simulator
releases.summary:
Parcels don’t deliver themselves, and the city won’t make things easy for you. Take the wheel and face the intense daily grind of a delivery driver, navigating busy streets, tight shortcuts, and surprises at every corner. Collect orders, load the cargo, and plan the best route to arrive on time.

Unlock achievements by completing special objectives, beating the clock without crashing your car, and maintaining delivery streaks with no delays. More challenges mean more reasons to improve with every run!

The goal is simple: deliver as much as possible, earn rewards, buy a variety of insane vehicles, and upgrade your operation to become a true reference in the city. Because here, every second counts and every delivery makes a difference!

releases.name: Cozy Cat Shop
releases.summary:
※本作は日本語に対応しておりません。

街で一番居心地の良い「猫ショップ」を経営してみたいと思ったことはありませんか？

「Cozy Cat Shop（コージー・キャット・ショップ）」へようこそ！ここは、愛らしい猫たち、幸せなお客様、そして無限の可能性が出会う場所です。夢のお店を作り上げ、魅力あふれる様々な猫種と出会い、お客様が運命の猫と巡り合えるような、温かみのある空間を創り出しましょう。

最初は小さなお店からスタートし、賑やかな「猫の楽園」へと成長させていきましょう。スペースを広げ、インテリアを自分好みにカスタマイズし、ビジネスを拡大しながら、たくさんの愛らしい猫たちに囲まれる素敵な毎日を過ごしてください！

主な特徴：
- 多彩な猫種との出会い
- 居心地の良い猫ショップの経営・拡大
- お店のカスタマイズ
- ビジネスの成長

たくさんの愛らしい猫たちと出会いましょう！

releases.name: Crab Evolution Roguelite
releases.summary:
Can you build the perfect mutant and survive every dangerous stage?

Enter a dangerous pixel-art world where survival depends on how far you are willing to transform. Take control of a strange creature and fight through relentless waves of enemies in a fast-paced 2D roguelite where every run brings new dangers, new choices, and new opportunities to evolve.

Collect experience, discover powerful mutations, and reshape your creature with every decision you make. Combine passive effects, active abilities, and physical mutations to create unique builds that can completely change the way you fight and survive. Experiment with different combinations, adapt to unexpected challenges, and find the mutations that turn your creature into an unstoppable force.

Key Features:
• Powerful Mutations: Combine 60+ passive, 30+ active, and 30+ physical mutations to create unique builds.
• Transform Your Creature: Physical mutations change your character's appearance and shape the way you play.
• Fast-Paced Roguelite Action: Fight through intense enemy waves in challenging 2D survival runs.
• 4 Unique Maps: Explore dangerous pixel-art environments filled with different enemies and challenging encounters.
• Every Run Is Different: Adapt to random mutation choices and experiment with new builds every run.

releases.name: Moto X
releases.summary:
Ready, set, go! Six riders compete only one will win!

Revive the moto racing sipirit with this game, developed in 1994.

Compete against motorcycles of 250cc, 550cc, and 750cc in different tracks full of obstacles and the best riders.

Skills aren't going to be enough to win. Throughout the race you will find items that will give you power ups to help you beat your opponents. Use them to your advantage!

releases.name: Golf Up Oasis
releases.summary:
Enjoy Golf Up Oasis with friends and family!

Golf Up Oasis is a fun-loaded golf game you can play with up to 4 friends in several game modes. In Tournament mode, you can pick between the Classic or Points options, in which you earn points by getting good results in the Holes and making quick decisions for bigger bonuses.

releases.name: Top Down Rally Racing
releases.summary: Speed across sun-soaked island resorts in this fast-paced top-down rally racer. Tear through coastal roads, palm-lined circuits, and resort backstreets as you climb the ranks to become the ultimate rally champion.Features:- Island Resort Circuits – Race through vibrant tropical courses inspired by beautiful island resorts- Full Car Roster – Choose your ride from a selection of unique vehicles- 1-2 Player Local Multiplayer – Race solo or go head-to-head with a friend on the same screen- 3 Game Modes – Compete in multiple ways to prove your skill- Garage Customization – Personalize your car to match your style- Podium Finishes – Battle for the top spot after every race- Local Leaderboard – Chase the best times and challenge your friends- Save System – Jump back in anytime, right where you left off- French & English Language SupportGrab the wheel, hit the coast, and race your way to victory in the most scenic rally on the island!

releases.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
releases.summary: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

releases.name: Tenebris Somnia
releases.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. 

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.

releases.name: Primary School - English Grade 1
releases.summary:
A full year of English adventures! Join 7 lovable characters, blast through countless topics, ace every quiz and become an English superstar.

Make learning English feel easy, structured, and fun. With 7 lovable characters, kids explore the full Grade 1 curriculum through guided lessons, interactive quizzes, and friendly explanations. Smart progress tracking and spaced repetition help strengthen long-term memory. Perfect for parents and children learning together — or for confident young learners practicing independently.

releases.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! / Toy Story 3: Complete Edition
releases.summary:
Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles.

Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans.

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition

Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

releases.name: Tavern Talk: Complete Edition
releases.summary:
Discover the cozy fantasy world of Tavern Talk Complete Edition, the first-ever physical Nintendo Switch release of the beloved visual novel adventure.

This Deluxe Edition includes the full base game along with both the Pirate Palooza and Tempest Tantrum DLC on cartridge, delivering the complete Wayfarer’s Inn experience in one definitive package.

releases.name: MeowMeow Balls
releases.summary:
Punch Meow Balls and watch them roll! Bump, merge, and make them bigger!

A fun physics puzzle game where you roll cute Meow Balls!

●Punch the balls with a cat paw!
Use cat punches to send the balls flying, then merge matching balls to make them bigger.
The bigger the balls you make, the less space you have on the board. Keep playing without letting the balls fall!

●Meow Balls and cats!
The balls are cute, cat-shaped Meow Balls.
Collect Meow Balls and cats, then play with your favorites.
There's even a mode where cats jump in and cause some mischief!

●Go for high scores and best times!
Challenge yourself to get high scores and beat your best times.
Online Rankings let you compete with players from around the world.

releases.name: Asteranova
releases.summary: Fast-paced vertical scrolling space shooter featuring intense boss battles, challenging enemy waves, and score-driven arcade gameplay.

releases.name: The Mysterious Library
releases.summary:
A visual novel containing over 50 short stories!

The Mysterious Library is a visual novel.
Read your way through a variety of books, including eerie tales, heartwarming stories, and strange yet humorous adventures.
You can change the background music, featuring pieces such as Nocturne, Gnossienne, and Gymnopedie.
Try to read every book and complete the entire collection.

releases.name: Play & Learn My First KANJI
releases.summary:
Can you pick the right kanji? Make learning kanji fun! A great first step into kanji!

Ready to take your first steps into kanji? Pictures and familiar words make each question easy to approach.

Fill in the blank with the kanji that completes the word. This quiz is a fun way to get comfortable with kanji used in everyday language.

How to play:
• Look at the illustration and the word on screen
• Think about which kanji belongs in the blank
• Choose the correct answer from four kanji

There are no complicated controls—just choose an answer and move on to the next question. With 120 stages, you can learn a little at a time, review in short sessions, and enjoy steady progress.

Great for anyone who wants to:
• Get familiar with kanji for the first time
• Practice kanji and vocabulary through play
• Find an approachable quiz for young learners
• Think through questions together with family
• Enjoy a learning game in short bursts

Use the illustrations as clues and see which kanji fits. Take on all 120 stages and discover a variety of kanji and words!

releases.name: Super Arcade Soccer 2026
releases.summary: Fast-paced, classic arcade football with a next-gen feel and pinpoint control. The 90s soccer feel you loved, rebuilt with modern physics and a fresh cartoon style. Just in time for the 2026 World Cup.

releases.name: Shiba Stroll: Brain Puzzles Around Town
releases.summary:
Take a stroll with a clever Shiba!

What would you discover on a relaxing walk through town with an adorable Shiba Inu?

Explore charming scenery inspired by every season, from old-fashioned streets and waterfront neighborhoods to lively nighttime lanes, snowy views, and valleys filled with fall colors. Somewhere in each scene, your Shiba companion is waiting for you.

This is a picture puzzle where scattered pieces must be returned to their proper positions to complete the view.

How to play:
• Study the scattered pieces carefully
• Look for connections between buildings, roads, and the sky
• Rotate and arrange the pieces to complete the picture

Which roof connects to the next one? Where does the rest of the Shiba's body continue? Look closely at each detail and use your powers of observation to find the solution.

Every completed scene brings a small moment of discovery. Take your time, enjoy the changing seasons, and earn stars based on how quickly you finish each puzzle.

Perfect for dog lovers, fans of picture puzzles, and anyone who enjoys peaceful scenery and short, easygoing challenges. Take a little journey with your Shiba and see if you can complete every view!

releases.name: Pixel Combat: Zombie Shooter
releases.summary:
Pixel Combat Shooter - a first-person shooter where you fight for survival in a house that has become the last stronghold of humanity. Zombies from different eras and dimensions break through time portals. 

Build defenses, upgrade weapons, explore secrets, and try to stop the apocalypse.

releases.name: The Family Detective: Hidden Legacy
releases.summary:
Grab your notebook and dive into the investigation! Hidden Legacy is the first game in a new series by AviGames, blending retro-detective atmosphere with soft, cozy gameplay. Explore vintage cafes, ancient archives, and family mansions, unraveling the mystery step by step.

Step into a living, breathing city where every shadow conceals a secret and every stranger holds a piece of the truth. Piece together conflicting testimonies, follow carefully hidden clues through richly detailed cinematic scenes, and let your faithful dog lead you somewhere the map won't.

At its heart, this is a story about family, music, and memory - and one legendary singer who vanished before her final note. Every room is a puzzle. Every conversation pulls the thread a little tighter. The truth is in there somewhere. You just have to know where to look!

releases.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
releases.summary: Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3, now available for modern systems. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode, where you can customize your town and even play as Evil Emperor Zurg.
